response_templates.cancel_order: I can guide you on order cancellation. Please check your order details and the seller's cancellation policy.
response_templates.change_order: Please review your order status to see whether changes are still available.
response_templates.change_shipping_address: Please check your order status and account options as soon as possible to see whether the shipping address can be changed.
response_templates.check_cancellation_fee: Cancellation fees depend on the applicable order terms. Please review the fee information for your order.
response_templates.check_invoice: You can usually find invoice details in the order or billing section of your account.
response_templates.get_invoice: Please check your order history or billing section for invoice download options.
response_templates.payment_issue: I can help with general payment troubleshooting. Check the payment status and never share full card details or passwords.
response_templates.check_payment_methods: Available payment methods are normally shown during checkout or in payment settings.
response_templates.get_refund: For a refund request, review the seller's refund process and the status of your order.
response_templates.track_refund: Refund timing depends on the seller and payment provider. Check your account or contact official support for an update.
response_templates.check_refund_policy: Please review the seller's refund policy for eligibility, timelines, and conditions.
response_templates.track_order: You can usually track an order from your order history or the tracking link in your confirmation message.
response_templates.delivery_period: Delivery estimates depend on the destination, shipping method, and seller. Check the estimated date in your order details.
response_templates.delivery_options: Available delivery options are generally shown during checkout.
response_templates.place_order: To place an order, add the desired items to your cart and follow the checkout steps.
response_templates.set_up_shipping_address: You can usually add a shipping address in account settings or during checkout.
response_templates.create_account: Use the sign-up option and follow the instructions to create an account.
response_templates.edit_account: Account details can generally be updated from your profile or account settings.
response_templates.delete_account: Please review account settings or contact the service's official support team to request account deletion.
response_templates.recover_password: Use the 'Forgot password' option and follow the password-reset instructions.
response_templates.registration_problems: Check that required fields are complete and your email address is entered correctly. If the issue continues, contact support.
response_templates.switch_account: If the service supports multiple accounts, sign out and sign in with the intended account.
response_templates.newsletter_subscription: Newsletter subscription settings are usually available in your profile or at the bottom of newsletter emails.
response_templates.review: You can usually submit feedback or a review from the product or order page.
response_templates.complaint: I'm sorry you're experiencing a problem. Please describe the issue without including sensitive personal or payment information.
response_templates.contact_customer_service: Please use the service's official customer-support channel for help with your specific case.
response_templates.contact_human_agent: For help from a person, please use the service's official contact or live-chat option.

fallback_response: I'm not fully sure I understood that. Could you rephrase your question or contact the service's official support team?
